subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Is scheduler-level coverage plus the skipped Mantis fixed:true manifest acceptable proof for this internal wake-false media fallback, or must this PR wait for live gateway/Telegram proof?
rationale: The artifact does not show observed before/after user-visible delivery, but the path may require a special proof hook; automation cannot decide whether to waive the external PR real-behavior proof gate.

options.title: Accept Internal-Path Evidence
